Tools

List of tools gathered by the Scottish Government

Zoom

This is a clear winner at the moment of writing (March 2020).

The free subscription will only allow 40 min sessions if there are more than 3 users.

There are some issues though: Zoom’s attention-tracking feature is ripe for misuse

Funretro

Online tool for retro - there is a free plan.

Miro

We can share a board for people to view it, but if we want occasional users to edit things, we might need to have a special licence for this.
